notes.title: Illistrated update
notes.notes:
I happy to annonce that it has been about a year sence I started working on this game 

To celibrate I have made a new update for this game that I think turrned out really well 

so here are the new features


 New boss

 4 new songs (every boss now has there own theme and the final bosses first theme now has its own song)

 illustration for some events to help show rather than tell whats going on

 Many sound effects in lots of events

 You now will only get events from stopping at gas stations when you have traveled a bit since your last stop

 endless mode

 TONS of bug and grammar fixes 

I am very proud of myself with this update I think the game is substantially better than it was before now its a little Ironic that it took about a year to get the game to this place but I really would not of had it any other way 

As for more updates there are like 2 more things I want to add at some point but don't expect updates too often because I have other things to do besides working on this game.

Thanks for reading (and playing by extenstion)

notes.title: Very Minor update today
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that made useless raltz have a 9998/10000 chance of being encountered (with the wrong diolog) after getting bad Karma

Fixed a bug that would make you keep your radio even after abandoning it.

notes.title: medium sized update releaseing today
notes.notes:
I had a few things I had to fix anyway so I figured why not add some stuff while I was at it

 new stuff

new boss (no new music for him unforchanitly)

new achivement

new codes

all bosses are now more difficult in hard mode

new Item (dropped from the new boss)

A few other new things that are too minor to mention here 



fixes 

You no longer get progress towards the 50 wins achivement when you are in custom event only mode.

You no longer get the finsh the game with 100 grain achivement when you are in custom event only mode

The baseball players will no longer pitch again after you hit back the tornado 

Improvements to the Useless Raltz AI

There are now hints on how to get the pro wordsmith achivement, and a new achivement which you get in a simalar way.

Display fixes (game used to have points where it would say you lost 10 grain when you only lost 5)

Reduced healing cost in battle to 5 grain instead of 10. 

Fixed a bug that caused the detour caused by the nuclear blast to be infinite.

Changed the codes menu from saying "enter back" to "use code back" per a request

fixed a bug where one of the calculus problems had no right answer

Various other fixes I can't remeber off the top of my head.


And thats about it 

thanks for reading
